name: Locust
description: Open-source performance/load testing tool allowing test scenarios defined in regular Python code, with event-based architecture and web-based UI.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present; Dockerfile.ci and Dockerfile.otel variants; Docker Hub: locustio/locust

eval_notes: Python-native load testing (27k+ stars) with distributed testing support. Custom client implementations allow testing any protocol. Real-time web UI. Excellent for writing agentic evaluation scenarios in Python.
